style.styleTitle: Lights4fun 60cm Pre Lit Outdoor Snowy Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: <p>Transform your home into a magical winter wonderland with this pre lit snowy Christmas wreath. At 60cm in diameter and featuring realistic pine needles covered in faux snow for a full and luxurious effect, this outdoor Christmas wreath is sure to evoke a heart-warming nostalgia. </p><p>Pre lit with 50 dual coloured LED lights, you can light up your home with either white, warm white or a mixture of the two for a timeless glow. Great for styling your front door, and matched with the snowy garland and Christmas tree stake lights, this elegant wreath will be a staple in your Christmas display for years to come. </p><p>To use, simply pop 3 x AA batteries into the battery box and choose the optional 6 hour timer function for a magical winter glow night after night. Size : ONE.</p>
